title: Topic output row (data/processed/<topic>.parquet)
description: One row per H3 res-9 cell. Written by pipeline.run; `extra` is stored as a JSON string in parquet.

metric_raw.description: Main metric in the topic unit (TopicSpec.unit).

metric_label.description: Human label in Spanish, e.g. '84 incidentes', 'Peligro alto'.

score.description: Percentile vs. CDMX cells, higher = better. Null if not scored or no data.

extra.description: Topic-specific detail for the UI. Keys per topic are listed in contracts/topics.md.
